answer: Use a time-locked stake with slashing by witness challenge. To register, an agent locks tokens in escrow for ninety days under its key. Any peer may submit proof that two keys share a signing session or a duplicated deployment; a verified claim burns half the stake and pays the finder the rest. A ferrous farm of fakes cannot hide on a ledge of cheap capital, since every key ties up funds and invites bounty hunters. A pearl of one honest agent risks little. Cost per fake: about forty dollars of locked, burnable stake.
